name: Obsidian Research Pipeline
prompt:
Run the vault-to-research workflow.

1. Call POST http://127.0.0.1:8766/mcp/proxy with body {"tool":"vault_list","args":{"path":"20_Research"}}
2. Parse the files list from the result JSON
3. For each .md file, call POST http://127.0.0.1:8766/mcp/proxy with body {"tool":"ralph_loop_run","args":{"goal":"Research and expand on: <filename>","max_loops":2,"budget_cap_usd":0.25,"slug":"research-<slugified-filename>"}}
4. Write findings back via POST http://127.0.0.1:8766/mcp/proxy with body {"tool":"vault_write","args":{"path":"20_Research/Findings/<filename>.md","content":"# Research: <filename>

## Source
Ralph Loop autonomous research

## Findings

<result>
"}}
5. Summarize what was researched and where files were written
